reader.requirement: At 85, in DIVIDE formats 4 and 5 with ON SIZE ERROR, a size error on the quotient (overflow, ROUNDED overflow, zero divisor) must leave identifier-3 and identifier-4 unchanged, and a size error on the remainder alone must leave identifier-4 unchanged while the quotient is stored; the ON SIZE ERROR branch runs and NOT ON SIZE ERROR does not.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal (2002+): only a statement with NO size-error phrase; with the phrase the two-phase shape is the same at every edition
1985 unsigned-subsidiary arm for the remainder value (not the store decision)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: div8.cob prints the same 16 lines at --std 85 and --std 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f04_04 covers quotient overflow, zero divisor and remainder overflow; the probes add ROUNDED-caused quotient overflow, a numeric-edited remainder overflow, a signed negative overflow, NOT ON SIZE ERROR alone with a zero divisor, and a remainder subscripted by identifier-3

probes.expected: quotient size error (A, D ROUNDED 10.0, I negative): both unchanged; remainder size error (B, E edited): quotient stored, remainder unchanged; zero divisor with only NOT ON (C): NOT ON not run; G remainder stored at RT(4) after IX=4 (GR4); H quotient size error leaves IX and table unchanged

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR8  (6.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VI.6.4.2  (6.4.2 The ON SIZE ERROR Phrase)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GR3

reader.notes: The quotient stores through GuardedStore, which sets the size-error flag on overflow without storing; the remainder store is emitted inside if(!sizeErr), so a quotient size error skips it, and its own GuardedStore leaves it unchanged on its own overflow. A zero divisor raises before either store.

refuter.evidence: div8r.cob at --std 85 and 2023 (runs/div8r-001/-002, identical): quotient 15 into PIC 9 BINARY -> SE, both unchanged (5 6) per VI.6.4.2(3) PICTURE limit; remainder 49 into PIC 9 BINARY -> SE, quotient stored 01, remainder unchanged 6 (GR8b); 99.9 into 9P -> quotient 90 stored by low-order truncation (VI.6.4.1), remainder 99 overflows PIC 9 -> SE, remainder unchanged; ROUNDED 95 -> 100 into 9P -> quotient SE, both unchanged (80 5) (GR8a); no size error -> NOT ON branch. cites: OK  §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR8  (6.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8; OK  §1985:VI.6.4.2  (6.4.2 The ON SIZE ERROR Phrase)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GR3.
